testcase.name: Generation and placement are both decided in allocation order: a lower group never displaces a higher one
Rotation: with the same m requests for m consecutive ticks, each is first in its group exactly once and served once
Allocation order: ACTION, NORMAL, AMBIENT; ids ascending, rotated by floorMod(tick, m) within each group
Strict priority: ACTION is served before NORMAL whatever the ids, input order or tick; NORMAL has no reserve
